commit_message:
Fix backfill reads/None-overwrite and content_hash_key_info (review of #19)

- backfill decides on key presence only (PREFER_TARGET with a presence key
  info): it reads no master value and each pushed copy value once, and a
  None-valued master key is no longer overwritten.
- content_hash_key_info hashes str/bytes-like values with a type tag (str via
  surrogatepass) and returns any other value as is, so verify compares it
  with == instead of a repr() digest.
- Tests: None-valued master, read counter on backfill, key_info decides in
  both directions (with .get blocked), reconcile stats, default content hash.
- Rewrite the garbled module docstring; drop duplicate Iterable/Protocol
  imports.
